requirement.md.content:
# Preferences behavior

Status: established test fixture.

## AC-1

An account owner can change email notices from the Preferences screen.
A confirmed save shows the message “Preferences updated”.
An unsuccessful save preserves the selected value and shows “Save failed”.

## AC-2

The primary save control is disabled while saving.

# Preferences UI test cases

**UNVERIFIED: Bind setup, actions, and assertions before execution. Owner: unknown. No executable framework was supplied.**

Alex means an account owner from [AC-1](requirement.md#L5).
The [business specification](business.md) defines the linked intent.
Each case starts with email notices unchecked and no save pending.
The test environment must control the next save's confirmed, failed, or pending outcome.
These are required fixture states. No fixture API or executable binding was supplied.
Source inspection establishes labels and component markup. Rendered uniqueness remains unverified.
Do not interpret a displayed confirmation as proof of persistence after reload.
Execution status is `NOT_RUN` for every case.

## PREF-01

Criterion: [AC-1](requirement.md#L5).

```gherkin
Feature: Confirm an email notices change through Preferences
  @PREF-01
  Scenario: Confirm changed email notices
    Given Alex is the account owner on the Preferences screen
    And the checkbox labeled "Email notices" is unchecked inside the main region named "Preferences"
    And the next save outcome is a confirmed result
    When Alex checks the checkbox labeled "Email notices" inside the main region named "Preferences"
    And Alex clicks the button labeled "Apply changes" inside the main region named "Preferences"
    Then the status text "Preferences updated" is visible inside the main region named "Preferences"
```

## PREF-02

Criterion: [AC-1](requirement.md#L5).

```gherkin
Feature: Preserve a selected preference after a failed save
  @PREF-02
  Scenario: Report a failed email notices save
    Given Alex is the account owner on the Preferences screen
    And the checkbox labeled "Email notices" is unchecked inside the main region named "Preferences"
    And the next save outcome is an unsuccessful result
    When Alex checks the checkbox labeled "Email notices" inside the main region named "Preferences"
    And Alex clicks the button labeled "Apply changes" inside the main region named "Preferences"
    Then the alert with text "Save failed" is visible inside the main region named "Preferences"
    And the checkbox labeled "Email notices" is checked inside the main region named "Preferences"
```

## PREF-03

Criterion: [AC-2](requirement.md#L11).

```gherkin
Feature: Prevent primary save activation while a save is pending
  @PREF-03
  Scenario: Disable the primary save control during saving
    Given Alex is the account owner on the Preferences screen
    And the checkbox labeled "Email notices" is unchecked inside the main region named "Preferences"
    And the next save outcome remains pending
    When Alex checks the checkbox labeled "Email notices" inside the main region named "Preferences"
    And Alex clicks the button labeled "Apply changes" inside the main region named "Preferences"
    Then the button labeled "Saving…" is disabled inside the main region named "Preferences"
```
